He attended [[North Little Rock High School]] in [[North Little Rock, Arkansas]] during his senior year of high school, where he was named the #1 overall recruit in the class of 2022. ==High school Jordan Brand Classic|date=16 March 2022}} ===Recruiting=== Smith was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class, according to major recruiting services. On September 29, 2021, he committed to being on the college basketball team for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]], over other finalists [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]], [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]] and [[Arkansas–Pine Bluff Golden Lions men's basketball|Arkansas–Pine Bluff]]. Smith also received offers from Oklahoma, Georgetown, Kansas, North Carolina, Baylor, Florida, Butler, Kentucky, Oklahoma State, Texas, and Tennessee.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/32308769/arkansas-lands-4th-espn-100-recruit-no-6-ranked-nick-smith|title=Smith, No. 6-ranked recruit in '22, picks Arkansas|date=30 September 2021}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/college-basketball-recruiting-arkansas-beats-out-alabama-for-five-star-class-of-2022-guard-nick-smith-jr/l|title=College basketball recruiting: Arkansas beats out Alabama for five-star class of 2022 guard Nick Smith Jr}} Smith was a consensus top five recruit nationally and was named the #1 overall recruit in the 2022 class by 247Sports. {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2022}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Nick Smith | position = [[Point guard|PG]] / [[shooting guard|SG]] | hometown = [[Jacksonville, Arkansas|Jacksonville, AR]] | highschool = [[North Little Rock High School|North Little Rock]] (AR) | feet = 6 | inches = 5 | weight = 185 | 40 = | commitdate = September 29, 2021 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 5 | 247 stars = 5 | espn stars = 5 | espn grade = 94 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2022 | rivals ref title = Arkansas 2022 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2022 Arkansas Razorbacks Recruiting Class | rivals school = arkansas | scout s = | espn schoolid = 8 | 247 overall = 1 | rivals overall = 2 | espn overall = 3 | accessdate = May 13, 2022 | bball = yes }} ==College career== Smith was projected to be a starting guard for the [[2022–23 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas Razorbacks]] for the 2022–23 season, though a persistent knee injury kept him sidelined for the majority of the season. Smith has only appeared in seven games this season, scoring a total of 69 points during 141 minutes of playing time.{{Cite web |title=Arkansas - Season Statistics |url=https://arkansasrazorbacks.com/stats/mbb/2022-23/teamcume.htm |access-date=2023-02-12 |website=arkansasrazorbacks.com}} Smith is projected to be a lottery pick in the [[2023 NBA draft]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://arkansasrazorbacks.com/roster/nick-smith-jr/ Arkansas Razorbacks bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/s/smith-jr-nick.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Smith, Nick}} [[Category:2004 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Arkansas]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:People from Jacksonville, Arkansas]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
